# Set up

```{r, warning = F, message = F}
# Set up 
library(tidyverse)
library(MASS)
library(glmnet)
library(ranger)
library(pROC)

source("helpers.R")
```

```{r}
# For reproducibility first, create a data frame with seeds 

set.seed(8967)

scenario_3 <- runif(100, min = 0, max = 1000000000) %>% floor()
scenario_4 <- runif(100, min = 0, max = 1000000000) %>% floor()
external_2 <- runif(100, min = 0, max = 1000000000)%>% floor()

seeds <- tibble(
  scenario_3 = scenario_3, 
  scenario_4 = scenario_4, 
  external_2 = external_2
)

# quick check that there are no doubles 
any(scenario_3 %in% scenario_4)
intersect(scenario_3, scenario_4)

unique(scenario_3) %>% length
unique(scenario_4) %>% length

# save seeds 
saveRDS(seeds, "seeds_non_linear.RDS")
```

# Data Generation 
```{r}
# Generate a non-linear data set 

n = 10000
train_set <- generate_data_nl(n, seed = 123)
```

```{r}
# Make some plots to explore the data 
df <- train_set %>% mutate(eta = qlogis(true_p))

# 1. Marginal shape: eta vs each predictor ---------------------------------
df %>%
  pivot_longer(X1:X12, names_to = "pred", values_to = "x") %>%
  mutate(pred = factor(pred, levels = paste0("X", 1:12))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x, eta)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.05, size = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "gam", formula = y ~ s(x), colour = "salmon") +
  facet_wrap(~ pred, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(y = "logit(true p)")

# 2. Interactions: slope of one variable should change with the other ------
plot_int <- function(d, v1, v2) {
  d %>%
    mutate(grp = cut(.data[[v2]], quantile(.data[[v2]], c(0, 1/3, 2/3, 1)),
                     labels = c("low", "mid", "high"), include.lowest = TRUE)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(.data[[v1]], eta, colour = grp)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.05, size = 0.5) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
    labs(colour = paste(v2, "tertile"), y = "logit(true p)") +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = quantile(d$eta, c(0.10, 0.99))) 
}
plot_int(df, "X7", "X8")   # strong: lines should clearly fan out
plot_int(df, "X1", "X2")   # weak: slopes go from negative to positive
plot_int(df, "X3", "X4")   # weak: reversed sign, so the fan flips

# 3. Check on the outcome ------------------------------------------
mean(df$y == "1")          # prevalence
ggplot(df, aes(true_p)) + geom_histogram(bins = 50)
```

```{r}
# check on the coeffs

fit <- lm(eta ~ I(X1*X2) + I(X3*X4) + I(X5^4) + I(X6^4) + I(X7*X8) + I(X9^4), data = df)
coef(fit)
# expect: intercept -1.4649, X1X2 0.161, X3X4 -0.161, X5^4 0.161,
#         X6^4 0.161, X7X8 0.483, X9^4 -0.483

summary(fit)$r.squared   # should be 1
```

```{r}
# Train a random forest model, and save it -- this is the new data-generating model 
# TAKES A WHILE TO RUN 

rf_dgm    <- rf_fit(train_set)

saveRDS(rf_dgm, "rf_dgm.RDS")
```

```{r}
# Using the random forest data-generating model, generate 100 data sets for each sample size scenario

rf_dgm <- readRDS("rf_dgm.RDS")

# scenario 3 
n = 458

for(i in c(1:100)){
  
  df <- generate_data_nl(n, seed = seeds$scenario_3[i]) # just to generate new predictors
  X  <- df[, grep("^X", names(df))]
    
  rf_p  = predict(rf_dgm, data = df)$predictions[, "1"]
  rf_y  = rbinom(nrow(X), size = 1, prob = rf_p) %>% as.factor()
  
  nl_data = bind_cols(X, "true_p" = rf_p, "y" = rf_y, "id" = df$id)
  
  saveRDS(nl_data, paste0("raw_data/scenario_3/sc_3_dataset_",i,".RDS"))
}

# scenario 4 
n = 229
for(i in c(1:100)){
  
  df <- generate_data_nl(n, seed = seeds$scenario_4[i]) # just to generate new predictors
  X  <- df[, grep("^X", names(df))]
    
  rf_p  = predict(rf_dgm, data = df)$predictions[, "1"]
  rf_y  = rbinom(nrow(X), size = 1, prob = rf_p) %>% as.factor()
  
  nl_data = bind_cols(X, "true_p" = rf_p, "y" = rf_y, "id" = df$id)
  
  saveRDS(nl_data, paste0("raw_data/scenario_4/sc_4_dataset_",i,".RDS"))
}


# extra data sets  to check external validation of models 
n = 1000

for(i in c(1:100)){
  
  df <- generate_data_nl(n, seed = seeds$external_2[i]) # just to generate new predictors
  X  <- df[, grep("^X", names(df))]
    
  rf_p  = predict(rf_dgm, data = df)$predictions[, "1"]
  rf_y  = rbinom(nrow(X), size = 1, prob = rf_p) %>% as.factor()
  
  nl_data = bind_cols(X, "true_p" = rf_p, "y" = rf_y, "id" = df$id)
  
  saveRDS(nl_data, paste0("raw_data/external_2/external_2_dataset_",i,".RDS"))
}
```

# Original Analyses (model training)
```{r}
# original analysis 
seeds <- readRDS("seeds_non_linear.RDS")

# scenario 3

for(i in c(1:100)){
  
  # read in a data set
  df <- readRDS(paste0("raw_data/scenario_3/sc_3_dataset_", i, ".RDS"))
  
  # fit two models 
  random_forest <- do_rf( data_set = df, seed = seeds$scenario_3[i], iter = i)
  elastic_net   <- do_glm_nl(data_set = df, seed = seeds$scenario_3[i], iter = i)
  
  # store models 
  saveRDS(random_forest$model, paste0("results/models/scenario_3/scenario_3_iter_", i,"_random_forest.RDS"))
  saveRDS(elastic_net$model, paste0("results/models/scenario_3/scenario_3_iter_", i,"_elastic_net.RDS"))
  
  # store results predictions 
  saveRDS(bind_rows(random_forest$results, elastic_net$results), paste0("results/predictions/scenario_3/scenario_3_iter_", i,"_og_results.RDS"))
  
  # store hyperparameters 
  saveRDS(random_forest$hyperparameters, paste0("results/hyperparameters/random_forest/scenario_3/scenario_3_iter_", i,"_hps.RDS"))
  saveRDS(elastic_net$hyperparameters,  paste0("results/hyperparameters/elastic_net/scenario_3/scenario_3_iter_", i, "_hps.RDS"))
}

# scenario 4

for(i in c(1:100)){
  
  # read in a data set
  df <- readRDS(paste0("raw_data/scenario_4/sc_4_dataset_", i, ".RDS"))
  
  # fit two models 
  random_forest <- do_rf( data_set = df, seed = seeds$scenario_4[i], iter = i)
  elastic_net   <- do_glm_nl(data_set = df, seed = seeds$scenario_4[i], iter = i)
  
  # store models 
  saveRDS(random_forest$model, paste0("results/models/scenario_4/scenario_4_iter_", i,"_random_forest.RDS"))
  saveRDS(elastic_net$model, paste0("results/models/scenario_4/scenario_4_iter_", i,"_elastic_net.RDS"))
  
  # store results predictions 
  saveRDS(bind_rows(random_forest$results, elastic_net$results), paste0("results/predictions/scenario_4/scenario_4_iter_", i,"_og_results.RDS"))
  
  # store hyperparameters 
  saveRDS(random_forest$hyperparameters, paste0("results/hyperparameters/random_forest/scenario_4/scenario_4_iter_", i,"_hps.RDS"))
  saveRDS(elastic_net$hyperparameters,  paste0("results/hyperparameters/elastic_net/scenario_4/scenario_4_iter_", i, "_hps.RDS"))
}
```

# Internal Validation 
```{r, warning = F, message = F}
# visualize results from original analyses 

# scenario 3 results 

results <- tibble()

 for(i in 1:100){
    
    read <- 
      paste0("results/predictions/scenario_3/scenario_3_iter_", i,"_og_results.RDS") %>% 
      map(readRDS) %>% 
      as.data.frame()
    
    results <- bind_rows(results, read)
 }

performance_metrics <- calculate_pms(results)

performance_metrics %>% 
    pivot_longer(cols = c(auc, brier), 
                 names_to = "metric", 
                 values_to = "value") %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = model, y = value, color = model)) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.1, alpha = 0.4) +
    facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL,
      title = "Scenario 3: Performance metrics per model"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

results %>% 
  mutate(y = as.numeric(y)-1) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = pred_p, y = y, group = iter, colour = model)) +
    geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, alpha = 0.5, linewidth = 0.05) +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, colour = "black") +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
    labs(
      x = "Predicted probability",
      y = "Observed outcome",
      title = "Scenario 3: Calibration curves"
    ) +
  facet_wrap(~model)+
  theme_minimal()
```

# External Validation 

```{r}
results = tibble()
scenario = 3

 for(i in 1:100){
    
    # read in external data set
    ext <- readRDS(paste0("raw_data/external_2/external_2_dataset_", i, ".RDS"))
    X   <- ext[, grep("^X", names(ext))]

    # this needs to match the non-linear dgm to have a fair glm comparison
    X_nl <- model.matrix(~ I(X1*X2) + I(X3*X4) + I(X5^4) + I(X6^4) + I(X7*X8) + I(X9^4) +
                           X10 + X11 + X12, data = ext)[, -1]
    
    # models 
    path <- paste0("results/models/scenario_", scenario, "/scenario_", scenario, "_iter_", i)
    rf   <- readRDS(paste0(path, "_random_forest.RDS"))
    en   <- readRDS(paste0(path, "_elastic_net.RDS"))
    
    # predictions
    rf_res <- ext %>% 
      dplyr::select(id, true_p, y) %>% 
      mutate(pred_p = predict(rf, data = X)$predictions[, "1"], 
             model  = "random_forest", 
             iter   = i)
    
    en_res <- ext %>% 
      dplyr::select(id, true_p, y) %>% 
      mutate(pred_p = as.numeric(predict(en, newx = X_nl, s = en$lambda, type = "response")), 
             model  = "glmnet", 
             iter   = i)
    
    results <- bind_rows(results, rf_res, en_res)
 }

performance_metrics <- calculate_pms(results)

performance_metrics %>% 
    pivot_longer(cols = c(auc, brier), 
                 names_to = "metric", 
                 values_to = "value") %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = model, y = value, color = model)) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.1, alpha = 0.4) +
    facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL,
      title = "Scenario 3: External performance metrics per model"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

results %>% 
  mutate(y = as.numeric(y)-1) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = pred_p, y = y, group = iter, colour = model)) +
    geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, alpha = 0.5, linewidth = 0.05) +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, colour = "black") +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
    labs(
      x = "Predicted probability",
      y = "Observed outcome",
      title = "Scenario 3: External calibration curves"
    ) +
  facet_wrap(~model)+
  theme_minimal()
```
